specs.title: F04 reschedule then cancel the same appointment (no duplicates)
F05 odonto: no price unless asked; exact price when asked
F06 oficina quote: approval only on clear approval, stores approval_message_id
F07 human request: escalates, bot goes silent, owner replies, RESUME brings bot back
F08 take over pauses the bot; owner typing also pauses
F09 sensitive topics: safe template + escalation in every health pack
F10 complaint and angry customer: acknowledged, handed to the team
F11 spam: closed politely, repeats ignored, a real message reopens
F12 LGPD: "apaguem meus dados" wipes contact, messages and appointments
F13 opt-out and opt-in
F14 price negotiation never produces an off-list price
F15 pix key and review link come verbatim from tenant data
F16 voice note (real whisperX) and photo (real gemma3 vision) through the API
F17 corrupt audio fails gracefully (bot still answers, owner sees why)
F18 concurrency: 5 customers at once are all answered (single generation queue)
F19 rapid double message from one customer: every message answered, no duplicate replies

specs.title: F20 Ollama down: graceful fallback reply, then handoff; health reports not ok
F21 reminders via time travel: confirm_24h/2h fire with CTA, "1" confirms, "2" opens reschedule
F22 owner marks done -> review request with link; no-show -> guilt-free recovery
F23 reactivation after the pack window respects opt-out
F24 admin metrics match the database
F25 global invariants over every assistant message produced in this QA run
U01 composer: Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a newline, mic swaps to send button
U02 emoji picker inserts at the cursor
U03 XSS: HTML in messages renders as text, never executes
U04 photo: preview with caption, bubble, lightbox open/close, vision in owner view
U05 mic recording with a fake microphone: recorder bar, cancel, record and send
U06 voice note upload: player plays and shows duration; transcript in owner view
U07 profile edit changes the WhatsApp name the business sees
U08 "Limpar conversa" wipes the thread and the chat still works
U09 theme toggle cycles auto -> light -> dark and persists
U10 unread badge counts bot/owner messages on a chat that is not open
U11 owner info panel: appointment Done sends the review request into the thread
U12 escalation banner, resolve, take over / resume through the UI
U13 live updates survive a proxy that buffers SSE (polling fallback)
U14 admin: metrics, tenant filter, report links, time travel buttons
U15 layout: no horizontal overflow at 1280, 1440 and 1920 widths; no console errors
U16 phone layout (375px): list and conversation one at a time, back button, owner view too
